label: Donato Bramante

claims.statement: Architect at the Sforza court. The bar shows the years both were in Milan, not a recorded friendship. Shared interest in central plan churches is traced in Leonardo's sketches. The contact is inferred from overlap in time and subject.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Inference from co presence in Milan.

claims.statement: Born in 1444 at Monte Asdrualdo (Fermignano) near Urbino.

sources.cite: Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.

claims.statement: Died in Rome on 11 March 1514, during Leonardo's Roman years.

sources.cite: Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.

value.text: Milan cathedral crossing tower consultations, 1487 to 1490

claims.statement: Both men are recorded in the cathedral's fabric records in connection with the tiburio: Leonardo with payments for a model (1487 to 1488) and Bramante with a written opinion (c.1488 to 1490). Shared involvement is documented; personal exchange is not.

sources.cite: Annali della fabbrica del Duomo, as cited in biographies. Model recall, not checked in this session.

value.text: Antiquarie prospettiche romane dedicated to Leonardo

claims.statement: A printed poem, Antiquarie prospettiche romane (c.1500), by a 'Prospectivo melanese depictore', is dedicated to Leonardo; its attribution to Bramante is debated.

sources.cite: Standard literature. Model recall, not checked in this session.
